harmony.title: InHarmony
harmony.description: InHarmony is a platform for voluntary support and fundraising. Users can make one-time donations or set up a monthly subscription for automatic donations. The website supports two languages — Ukrainian and English — and features a responsive, user-friendly interface.
features: One-time donation and monthly subscription system
UA / EN language support
Payment system integration
Personal dashboard and analytics for volunteers
Frontend with Next.js
Backend with Node.js
Fully responsive design

full-stack.title: LLOYDJEFFERSON – personal fullstack developer website
full-stack.description: Interactive personal website of developer Lloyd Jefferson with light and dark theme switching. The website contains information about the developer, projects, contacts and client reviews. The project demonstrates a professional approach, responsive design and modern interactivity.
features: Light and dark theme with smooth switching
Sections: About me, Projects, Contacts, Reviews
Interactive contact form with message sending
Responsive layout for various devices
Client reviews with quotes and names
Social media icons with links
Built with pure JavaScript and CSS without frameworks

diet-today.title: VeggieBoost – organic vegetable delivery
diet-today.description: VeggieBoost is a landing page for an online organic vegetable delivery service. The project showcases basket ordering functionality, simple navigation and appealing UI design.
features: Interactive interface with sections: How it works, Vegetables, Contacts
Online shop simulation with product selection and ordering
Modern animations and smooth scrolling
Vegetable list with prices, icons and order button
Basic responsiveness for various devices

glasses.title: Learn Lingo
glasses.description: Learn Lingo is a web application for a company offering online language teachers. Users can register, log in, view teacher profiles, add them to favourites and book trial lessons.
features: Registration and login via Firebase Authentication
View and filter teachers by language, level and hourly rate
Favourites list that persists after page reload
Detailed teacher information with ratings and reviews
Modal windows for registration, login and booking with form validation
Animations for smooth element appearance
Interactive pagination and load more button

qvrix.title: QVRIX
qvrix.description: QVRIX is my own multilingual website that I developed for my project specialising in web development and video production. The project was built with a modern tech stack — including Next.js, SCSS and Sanity CMS for dynamic blog content. The site features responsive design, user-friendly navigation and multilingual support via i18n.
features: Multilingual support (i18n) with automatic language detection
Blog system based on Sanity CMS with dynamic content management
Clearly structured content: services, portfolio and contact
Responsive design for optimal display on all device types
SEO-optimised page structure with server-side rendering (Next.js)
Modular and maintainable architecture following modern development standards
